_comment: Briscola locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (A, 2..7, J, Q, K), the suit symbols (carried in the {card}/{trump_card} slots), or numeric counts/points/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol (♠♥♦♣) - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. '7♠' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A card label, e.g. 'A♥' - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: The number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{points}: A number of points (card value or accumulated score)
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered score line, or the final per-player score block
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{tricks}: A number of tricks won by a player
_slots.{deck_count}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start: Eré Briscola bẹ̀rẹ̀! Àmì ìyẹ̀wò: {trump_suit} (Káàdì ìyẹ̀wò: {trump_card})

prompt.intro: O n ṣere Briscola - Player {player_id}. Ìlépa: Gba awọn ẹtan ati gba awọn aaye ti o pọ julọ (120 awọn aaye lapapọ ninu apo-iwe). Awọn aaye kaadi: A = 11, 3 = 10, K = 4, Q = 3, J = 2, awọn miiran = 0 Kaadi Agbara: A > 3 > K > Q > J > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2 Awọn kaadi Trump ṣẹgun awọn kaadi ti kii ṣe trump laibikita agbara. Iṣe: '[play X] ' nibi ti X jẹ ipo (1-{max_pos}) ti kaadi ni ọwọ rẹ

hand.empty: Kò sí káàdì kankan ní ọwọ́

trick.empty: Kò tíì sí ẹni tó ń fi káàdì ṣeré yìí.

turn.trump_info_deck: Àwọn àmì ìdíje: {trump_suit} | Àwọn kárí tó kù nínú pákì: {deck_count}
turn.board: {hand} {trick} Ìṣirò: {scores} {trump_info} Ṣẹ́ kaadi kan nípa lílo [play X]

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lo [play X] nibi ti X jẹ ipo kaadi (1, 2, 3, ati bẹbẹ lọ)
invalid_move.out_of_range: Àmì káàdì tí kò bágbà mu. O ní {count} káàdì (1-{count})

action.played: Ẹ̀yà orin {player_id} tí ó ń gbá {card}
action.trick_win: Ẹlẹ́dàá {winner} gba ẹ̀tàn náà pẹ̀lú {card} ó sì gba {points} àmì!

outcome.player_line: Ẹ̀yà orin {player_id}: {points} àwọn àmì ({tricks} àwọn ẹ̀tàn)
